snippet.title: Chip 'n Clawz vs. The Brainioids | Going Underground Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The “Going Underground” DLC for Chip 'n Clawz vs. The Brainioids is available now on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S!

Check out the “Going Underground” DLC on Steam: https://bit.ly/4dPAiLk

In the “Going Underground” DLC, Chip ‘n Clawz will face a new enemy faction, the Overseer’s army of bugs, as well as some familiar brain-faces. The DLC is a massive update to the game, featuring: 

- 11 new story missions
- 3 new PvP and Skirmish maps
- 7 new enemies and enemy buildings
- 4 new HQ upgrades, 2 new guns
- Dozens of new collectibles
- And an epic final boss!

And remember: Chip ‘n Clawz has a free Friend's Pass available now on PC, PlayStation 5, and Series X|S, that allow players to enjoy online co-op and PvP multiplayer for free with a friend who owns the full game. To ensure fair multiplayer matches, all DLC content that affects PvP and Skirmish is available for free to all players, DLC-owner or not. 

Details about Friend's Pass: https://www.chipnclawz.com/en/news/article/11577102

Join the official Discord: https://discord.gg/2DEGRggKA2
